fields.label: Reference Operation Time (Minutes)
fields.description: Operational reference only; ERPNext scheduling time remains controlled by the BOM.

fields.label: Normal Crew Requirement
fields.description: Approved normal crew and skill policy for this operation. Workstation and Card policies are merged and may only make the effective requirement stricter.

fields.label: Execution Mode
fields.options:
Single Workstation
Parallel Workstations
Sequential Split
fields.description: Single expects one Job Card. Parallel releases all workstation lanes together and combines their quantities. Sequential Split releases one Job Card lane at a time.

fields.label: Quantity Allocation
fields.description: Each execution lane uses the ERPNext Job Card For Quantity; all lanes are combined at operation level.

fields.label: Runtime Selection Priority
fields.options:
Oldest Work Order First
Smallest Remaining First
Largest Remaining First
fields.description: When a reusable Process or Station card is scanned, rank eligible open Job Cards using this rule. Item, operation, company, status, and Station-card workstation eligibility are always enforced first.

fields.label: Interruption Policy
fields.options:
Interruption Prohibited
Supervisor Controlled
Compatible Items Only
Unrestricted with Approval
fields.description: Controls whether active work may be paused to give way. Compatible Items Only requires matching Setup Family and Cleaning Class on both operation profiles.

fields.label: Setup Family
fields.description: Use the same value for items that can follow each other with minimal machine setup.

fields.label: Cleaning Class
fields.description: Cleaning/changeover compatibility group for this item and operation.

fields.label: Start Rule
fields.options:
Previous Operation Complete
Minimum Qty Available
Minimum Percentage Available
Full Batch Available
No Dependency
fields.description: Controls when this operation becomes Ready. Use minimum quantity/percentage for overlapping production; No Dependency should only be used when the operation is genuinely independent.

fields.label: Output Reporting Mode
fields.description: Completion Only reports final output from Job Card completion. Incremental permits operators to record good and rejected quantities during work.

fields.label: High-frequency Material Run Control
fields.description: Optional micro-run control for operations that must bind live material identity to incremental output. Leave Disabled for ordinary production.

fields.label: Material Run Control
fields.description: Required Before Progress gates each progress report behind one open Material Run. Disabled preserves the normal production flow.

fields.label: Output Boundary Requirement
fields.options:
None
First Run Only
Every Material Run
fields.description: Controls when the operator scans the first output serial or other production boundary for traceability.

fields.label: Allow Unused Material Carry-forward
fields.description: Allows unused quantity from one Material Run to remain available to the next run without rescanning the same source.

fields.label: ERP Settlement Timing
fields.options:
At Job Card End
At Work Order Manufacture Receipt
fields.description: Snapshot of when accumulated Material Run reservations will be reconciled to native ERPNext manufacturing stock entries.

fields.label: Handoff Mode
fields.options:
Physical Card Handoff
Digital Quantity Handoff
Full Batch Handoff
Automatic Handoff
fields.description: Physical requires a tag scan; Digital releases reported quantity in transfer multiples; Full Batch waits for completion; Automatic releases available output when completion is received.

fields.label: Completion Rule
fields.description: Full Qty requires the allocated quantity; Operator Complete accepts an explicit completion action; Threshold completes when the configured production threshold is achieved.
